name: @nuri/playground
description: Nuri playground · the build-free bench. A SEPARATE area from the DS docs (decision 57): a fixed light+cream surface where real screen compositions render live to validate the design system on real layouts. Consumer of @nuri/prototype (the build-free components it embeds) and @nuri/spec (the token cake). decision 68 · convergence phase 2 (A5).
//: build-free HTML pages. The committed generated/boot.js + generated/playground.css are emitted by the repo build, not by page authors: edit pages/*.html, refresh the browser. Cross-package assets still resolve via workspace-relative paths. DAG: playground → prototype → spec (NEVER → doc — doc is a consumer).
